owed.line: May the phone box's header carry the plain word Telephone, with no logo, until the town mints the Meridian operator's mark?

night.note: the street's only light is the lantern colour; the kiosk shows it on the stainless (a warm orange wash on the brushed steel) and the glass reflects it; the kiosk's own interior lamp is OFF in the sample (an unlit kiosk is the safe 1990 night; a lit one is for his taste page later)

placement.slot: east side, where the scene has it: centre x 16.5 m, centre z 3.675 m (the scene's 0.55 m set-back is to the kiosk's CENTRE from the kerb's back edge at z 3.125), the door facing the shopfront (+z, as the scene's kiosk_door at z 4.132 does) and the back sheet to the road; the box's faces at z 3.230 and 4.120 (890 deep), 105 mm from the kerb's back edge in front and 855 mm from the stallriser line (z 4.975) behind the door
placement.scene_line: furniture E3: east, x 16.5, setback 0.55 m (to the centre), plan 0.914, height 2.515 (K6 proportions): kiosk_plinth at z 3.675, faces at 3.218 and 4.132, door at z 4.132
reasons: the slot is the scene's own and is kept: x 16.5, centre z 3.675. The first version moved the box to x 23.5 on two reasons that do not hold. (1) It read the scene's 0.55 m set-back as the distance to the kiosk's front face and so counted 2.0 - 0.55 - 0.89 = 0.56 m of footway; the 0.55 m is to the centre (vignette-pieces.json kiosk_plinth stands at z 3.675 with a 0.914 plan: faces at 3.218 and 4.132), so the strip between the kiosk and the stallriser face (4.975) is 0.843 m with the scene's box and 0.855 m with this target's 890 box, both over the 0.68 m a walker needs; there was no walking-width reason to move it. (2) It argued that a kiosk must not stand before Rita's window: that is an inference, not a ruling; the box stood there on 2 October when Jafar ruled both 'the KX100 phone box stays' and 'Rita's window is the model', so no ruling is read to forbid it

the move to x 23.5 also failed the street's own pieces: the box (x 23.055 to 23.945, height 2192 on a footway 0.07 to 0.09 above the crown) lay under the empty unit's awning (awning_02 at x 24.0, x 22.5 to 25.5, its sheet 2.35 m above the crown over the box's front edge, its valance hanging to 1.63 m between z 3.39 and 3.40), left 0.45 to 0.6 m of walkable strip at head height in front of it, and stood across the empty unit's shop-door slot (x 22.294 to 23.300); the town's place for the kiosk (hook-cast.json places.kiosk, x 16.5, z 4.3, 'beside kiosk_plinth') and the meetings that use it (kiosk/ritas_step, kiosk/fish_counter) would have been 5.5 m from Rita's step. All of that is why the slot stays, and the shared placement rows (sd_place.py) now test the pose against every piece of vignette-pieces.json and the shopfronts target's door zones

the town's place for the kiosk, hook-cast.json places.kiosk (x 16.5, z 4.3), lies 0.18 m beyond the door's face (4.120) and 0.15 m beyond the pull (4.148), inside the 855 mm strip: the people who meet there stand at the door, exactly as before; DECISIONS 30 September records that Marta steps onto Rita's step (x 18.0) so that her friendship with Alison at the kiosk still meets, 1.5 m away as before

the door faces the shops, as the scene's own kiosk_door does (z 4.132); the back sheet, with the payphone's back, faces the road: from the hook camera (x -3, looking up the street) the player sees the stainless back and the lid, not the livery; the clear glazing of the sides shows the interior

clear of the lamp column at x 28 east (11.5 m), the pillar box at x 27 (10.5 m), the fish market's board (x 14.45 after the A-board target, 1.6 m), the railing (x 10 to 12) and the awnings (x 10.5 to 13.5 and 22.5 to 25.5): the shared placement rows read each of them from the scene
placement.orientation: the door faces +z in the street's frame (towards the shopfront), the back panel towards the road; the piece's own frame has the door at -y, so the pose's yaw is 180

variants_note: KX1 (the sample): the door kiosk. It stands in the street.

KX2: the doorless open kiosk (S3): the same lid, header, posts, back and payphone with no front leaf, glass, stiles or band; one more place for the town if it wants a second box (none in the scene today).
conditions (materials, not shapes): C0 sound, C1 grimy (the sample's wear), C2 one lower pane cracked in a star from a point 1 m above the ground (a mask on the glass, not a mesh).
glass: G0 clear (the sample), G1 smoked (transmission 0.55): the first deliveries of 1985 to 1986 and a few after; at most one in ten on the street.

text.header_note: the word is the plain English word, set in one line, upright, 100 mm tall letters in the middle of the header, in an OFL grotesque such as Liberation Sans (SIL OFL 1.1); no logo, no operator's name, no crown; colour a pale yellow-white (240, 224, 150); the mark the brand bible still owes is a placeholder: the upper pane's logo zone (centred, 300 x 300, from z 1250) stays empty
forbidden: any real operator's name or logo

not_settled: the 1990 header's lettering colour (the research note says yellow on black; no 1985 to 1991 photograph was reached; chosen pale yellow-white, Judgement)
the side fascia's height (S3 shows the header across the front; the side fascia is Judgement at the same height)
the interior (payphone, enclosure and notice frame positions are Judgement within about 30 mm: S3 is oblique)
whether Quay Street's box has a door (the sample has one; KX2 is the alternative)
smoked or clear glass for the single box (clear chosen: from 1988 on most were clear)
the exact lid lip profile (S2 shows a rolled lip; modelled as a 3 mm skirt with an 8 mm turned-in edge)
content_rule_note: no cards, no stickers, no people, no drink, no betting, nobody young: the kiosk stands empty (a statement of the content rule).
builder_notes: build by script from the parts; every part is a box or cylinder with the edges stated in its row; weld the stainless into one shape per post; glass is a separate mesh with a glass material and 4 mm thickness
replace production/assets/street/clutter/kx100-kiosk.glb with the new kiosk at the slot; the old asset stays in git
UVs: stainless 1 m tiling brushed (horizontal grain on the lid and back, vertical on the posts); header and handle panel one texture each
keep the foot gap open and the posts' feet 40 x 40 on the ground
